resources.string: Lets AGI Assistant perform the phone actions you ask for by voice or text: go back, go home, scroll, tap buttons, type text, read what is on the screen and take screenshots. The service only acts when you give a command. Screen content is never stored or sent anywhere except to the AI provider you configure, and only when you ask a question about the screen.
